Name: AutoForager
Author: DebugDew
Description:
[center][b][size=6]✨ AutoForager ✨[/size][/b]
[size=4][i]The ultimate automation tool for your daily chores![/i][/size][/center]

[size=4]Tired of running around the map every day? Let [b]AutoForager[/b] do the hard work. It collects items automatically and puts them in your chests. Made for [b]Stardew Valley 1.6+ and SMAPI 4.0+[/b].[/size]

[line]

[b][size=5]🌟 Core Features[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=4][b]Forage Collection:[/b] Collects wild plants, flowers and spring onions every morning ([i]Default: 06:10 AM[/i]).[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Smart Sorting (Sub-Chests):[/b] Don't want a messy main chest? Assign dedicated sub-chests for [i]Fruit & Bush[/i], [i]Mushrooms[/i] and [i]Beach[/i] items. If you don't set them, items safely fallback to your [i]Main Forage chest[/i]![/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Universal Bush Harvesting:[/b] Automatically harvests Salmonberries, Blackberries, and Tea Leaves! Perfectly supports all custom modded bushes (SVE, RSV, Alchemistry etc.)[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Moss Harvesting:[/b] Collects moss from trees.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Artifact & Seed Spots:[/b] Digs up worm spots (artifacts) and seeds.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Tree Shaking:[/b] Shakes trees to get your daily fruits and seeds.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Farm Cave Looting:[/b] Gets mushrooms or fruits from your farm cave.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Stealth Trash Raids:[/b] Checks town trash cans safely. Villagers will not see you, so you never lose friendship![/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Truffle Sweeper:[/b] Collects all truffles from your pigs in the evening ([i]Default: 05:00 PM[/i]).[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Custom Times:[/b] You can change the collection times in the mod menu.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Fair Play & Custom EXP:[/b] Earn Foraging XP from automated collections, or turn it OFF in the settings. Your skills (Botanist/Gatherer) work perfectly, and the mod [i]NEVER[/i] steals quest items (like Robin's Axe).[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Safe Overflow Protection:[/b] If a connected chest is full, your loot is never lost! Standard ground forage safely stays on the ground. Mid-air items (bush berries, artifacts, trash) bypass the full chest and go directly into your player inventory, instantly triggering a HUD warning.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Chest Overlay Indicator:[/b] Hold your hotkey ([i]Default: Left Alt[/i]) to see category labels above your chests. Labels turn [b]bright red[/b] if the chest is full.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Save System:[/b] All chest links and tracked maps are saved directly into your Stardew Valley save file. You will never lose them when updating the mod.[/size][/*]
[/list][line]

[b][size=5]📦 How It Works & Setup[/size][/b]

[list]
[*][size=4][b]Connect Your Chests:[/b] Stand near a chest, press [b]J[/b] (default key), and assign its category (Forage, Trash, Truffles, etc.). The menu dynamically tracks your chests—if you accidentally break or move one, the menu will safely show it as "NOT SET"![/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Smart Map Tracking:[/b] The mod comes pre-loaded with default locations ([i]Farm, Bus Stop, Pelican Town, The Beach, The Mountain, Backwoods and Cindersap Forest[/i]). For any other new map, just walk into it! The mod learns it automatically as you discover new areas—perfect for progressive gameplay![/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Turn Maps ON/OFF:[/b] Turn the mod ON or OFF for any specific map or customize your Overlay Key using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url].[/size][/*]
[/list][line]

[b][size=5]🔌 Compatibility[/size]

[size=4]Requires [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]. 100% works with [b]Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE), Ridgeside Village and East Scarp[/b].
[i](It works perfectly with other map mods too, but their names might look a bit weird in the menu).[/i][/size][/b]
